answer: Deposits are visible in jetty, and ledge reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 31% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 171 aliases, and each one needs its own funded pearl account. The attacker spends 94 dollars and 7 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
